# Load data

Load Seurat object.

```{r}
se
head(se[[]])
```


Load ranked gene lists (here from Open Targets). Please note that it is essential for downstream analysis that the gene lists are ranked from this point forward to do empirical selection of top genetic genes.
```{r class.source = 'fold-show'}

OpenTargets_MDD_Genetic_ <- as.character(t(read.table(file = "data/OpenTargets/ranked_gene_sets/OT-MONDO_0002009-associated-targets-9_15_2026-v26_06_weights_genetics_only_MDD_ranked.csv")))
length(OpenTargets_MDD_Genetic_)

```


Filter out genes not present in the Seurat object.
```{r}
# Extract gene names from the Seurat object
gene_names <- rownames(se)

# Remove genes not present in the Seurat object from the gene lists
OpenTargets_MDD_Genetic_ <- unique(OpenTargets_MDD_Genetic_[OpenTargets_MDD_Genetic_ %in% gene_names])
length(OpenTargets_MDD_Genetic_)

OpenTargets_MDD_Genetic_top_ <- OpenTargets_MDD_Genetic_[1:160]
length(OpenTargets_MDD_Genetic_top_)
```


Add pseudotime windows to metadata.
```{r}
assign_pseudotime_windows <- function(
  seurat_obj,
  pseudotime_col = "MetaCell_rank",
  window_size = 100,                  
  output_col = "pseudotime_windows"
) {
  meta <- seurat_obj@meta.data
  cells <- rownames(meta)

  # Extract pseudotime column
  pt_values <- meta[[pseudotime_col]]
  
  df <- data.frame(
    cell = cells,
    pseudotime = pt_values,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  # Order cells by pseudotime
  df_ordered <- df[order(df$pseudotime, na.last = TRUE), , drop = FALSE]

  # Identify non-NA pseudotime entries
  non_na_idx <- which(!is.na(df_ordered$pseudotime))
  n_non_na <- length(non_na_idx)

  # Handle case with no pseudotime values
  if (n_non_na == 0) {
    seurat_obj@meta.data[[output_col]] <- NA
    return(seurat_obj)
  }

  # ----- Create windows -----
  window_ids <- ceiling(seq_len(n_non_na) / window_size)

  # Merge last window if too small
  last_window_size <- n_non_na - (max(window_ids) - 1) * window_size
  if (last_window_size < window_size && max(window_ids) > 1) {
    window_ids[window_ids == max(window_ids)] <- max(window_ids) - 1
  }

  # Assign window labels
  labels <- rep(NA_character_, nrow(df_ordered))
  labels[non_na_idx] <- paste0("pt_window_", window_ids)

  # Return labels in original cell order
  labels_by_cell <- setNames(labels, df_ordered$cell)
  seurat_obj@meta.data[[output_col]] <- labels_by_cell[rownames(meta)]

  return(seurat_obj)
}

```


```{r}
se <- assign_pseudotime_windows(
  se,
  pseudotime_col = "cell_rank_ordered",
  window_size = 110
)

# Define the desired order of levels
desired_levels <- paste0("pt_window_", 1:11)

# Reorder the factor
se$pseudotime_windows <- factor(se$pseudotime_windows, levels = desired_levels)

# Check
table(se$pseudotime_windows)
```


Get Open Targets gene set and remove genes with zero variance in the SCT assay.
```{r}
# Fetch data
mydata <- FetchData(se, vars = OpenTargets_MDD_Genetic_top_)

# Compute standard deviation for each column
col_sds <- apply(mydata, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)

# Identify columns with zero variance
zero_var_cols <- names(col_sds[col_sds == 0])

# Print the columns
zero_var_cols

```


# Heatmap

```{r, fig.height=10, fig.width=10}
# Fetch your data from Seurat object
mydata <- FetchData(se, vars = OpenTargets_MDD_Genetic_top_)

# Identify and remove zero-variance columns
col_sds <- apply(mydata, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
zero_var_cols <- names(col_sds[col_sds == 0])
mydata_filtered <- mydata[, !colnames(mydata) %in% zero_var_cols]

# Compute Spearman correlation matrix
cormat <- cor(mydata_filtered, method = "spearman")

# Create a color function for the heatmap
col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(-1, 0, 1), c("blue", "white", "red"))

# Draw the heatmap
myheatmap <-  Heatmap(cormat,
        name = "Spearman\nCorrelation",
        col = col_fun,
        show_row_names = TRUE,
        show_column_names = TRUE,
        show_row_dend = F,
        cluster_rows = TRUE,
        cluster_columns = TRUE,
        row_names_side = "right",
        clustering_method_columns = "complete",
        clustering_method_rows = "complete",
        row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 3),
        column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 3),
        row_split = 3, 
        column_split = 3
)

myheatmap
```


PDF
```{r, eval=T}
pdf(file = "plots/Gene_gene_correlation_heatmap_top_160genes_MDD.pdf", height = 10, width = 10)

myheatmap

dev.off()
```

Add gene sets to a list.
```{r}
all_gene_sets <- list(dg_cluster1_=dg_cluster1_,dg_cluster2_=dg_cluster2_,dg_cluster3_=dg_cluster3_)
```


```{r}
score.mat <- matrix(data = NA, nrow = length(all_gene_sets), ncol = 1, dimnames = list(names(all_gene_sets), "% of genes present"))

for (i in 1:length(all_gene_sets)) {
  genes <- unlist(all_gene_sets[i]) 
  score.mat[i] <- mean(genes %in% rownames(se))
  se <- AddModuleScore(se,list(genes), ctrl = 100, name = list(names(all_gene_sets[i])))
}

score.mat*100
```


```{r}
make_color_shades <- function(color, n,
                        direction = c("light_to_dark",
                                      "dark_to_light",
                                      "dark_to_light_to_dark",
                                      "light_to_dark_to_light"),
                        v_light = 0.95, v_dark = 0.15,
                        peak_pos = NULL) {
  
  direction <- match.arg(direction)
  
  # Convert base color to HSV
  rgb_mat <- grDevices::col2rgb(color) / 255
  hsv_vals <- grDevices::rgb2hsv(rgb_mat)
  
  h <- hsv_vals["h", 1]
  s <- hsv_vals["s", 1]
  
  # Default peak position is middle if not specified
  if (is.null(peak_pos)) peak_pos <- ceiling(n / 2)
  if (peak_pos < 1 || peak_pos > n) stop("peak_pos must be between 1 and n")
  
  # Generate brightness sequence
  if (direction == "light_to_dark") {
    vals <- seq(v_light, v_dark, length.out = n)
    
  } else if (direction == "dark_to_light") {
    vals <- seq(v_dark, v_light, length.out = n)
    
  } else if (direction == "dark_to_light_to_dark") {
    # peak = lightest color at position peak_pos
    if (peak_pos == 1) {
      vals <- rep(v_light, n) # edge case: peak at first
    } else if (peak_pos == n) {
      vals <- rep(v_light, n) # edge case: peak at last
    } else {
      vals_up   <- seq(v_dark, v_light, length.out = peak_pos)
      vals_down <- seq(v_light, v_dark, length.out = n - peak_pos + 1)[-1]
      vals <- c(vals_up, vals_down)
    }
    
  } else if (direction == "light_to_dark_to_light") {
    # valley = darkest color at position peak_pos
    if (peak_pos == 1 || peak_pos == n) {
      vals <- rep(v_dark, n) # edge cases
    } else {
      vals_down <- seq(v_light, v_dark, length.out = peak_pos)
      vals_up   <- seq(v_dark, v_light, length.out = n - peak_pos + 1)[-1]
      vals <- c(vals_down, vals_up)
    }
  }
  
  # Build hex shades
  shades <- vapply(vals, function(v) grDevices::hsv(h, s, v), character(1))
  return(shades)
}

```



```{r}
col_dg1 <- make_color_shades("#377EB8", 11, direction = "light_to_dark")
col_dg2 <- make_color_shades("#4DAF4A", 11, direction = "dark_to_light")
col_dg3 <- make_color_shades("#984EA3", 11, direction = "dark_to_light_to_dark")
```



```{r, warning=FALSE,fig.height=5,fig.height=7}
VlnPlot(se, features = c("dg_cluster1_1"), group.by = "pseudotime_windows", cols = col_dg1)
VlnPlot(se, features = c("dg_cluster2_1"), group.by = "pseudotime_windows", cols = col_dg2)
VlnPlot(se, features = c("dg_cluster3_1"), group.by = "pseudotime_windows", cols = col_dg3)
```

## dg_cluster1

GO analysis
```{r}
gostres <- gost(query = dg_cluster1_, 
                organism = "hsapiens", ordered_query = F, # Biological processes
                multi_query = FALSE, significant = T, exclude_iea = FALSE, 
                measure_underrepresentation = FALSE, evcodes = T, 
                user_threshold = 0.05, correction_method = "g_SCS", 
                domain_scope = "annotated", custom_bg = NULL, 
                numeric_ns = "", sources = NULL, as_short_link = FALSE)

```


```{r}
gostplot(gostres, capped = TRUE, interactive = F)
```


```{r}
results <- gostres$result
results <- results[grep("GO:BP",results$source), ]
results <- arrange(results,p_value)
```

Save GO results
```{r, eval=T}
write_delim(results, "DEG_output/GO_Genes_MDD_top160_dg_cluster1.csv", delim = ";")
```


```{r}

results_plot <- na.omit(results[1:20,])

p <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(
    data = results_plot, 
    aes(
      x = reorder(term_name, -log10(p_value)), 
      y = -log10(p_value),
      size = intersection_size/term_size  # map size
    ), 
    color = "grey50",  # outline color
    fill = "grey70",   # fill color (uniform)
    shape = 21
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "GO:BP", 
    y = "-log10(adj.p-value)", 
    size = "GeneRatio"
  ) +
  ggtitle("dg_cluster1", subtitle = "Top 20") +
  guides(fill = "none")  # remove fill legend if still present

cowplot::plot_grid(p, ncol = 1)
```
